analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation addition to docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 456-468). It describes NAX kernels for routed NVFP4 experts (ModelOptNVFP4NAXExperts), NAX dense projections (ModelOptNAXDenseLinear), and speculative-round window submission and fusion env controls (DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_WINDOW_SUBMIT, DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_FUSION). The patch has no code, config, wire-contract, key-handling, attestation, or authorization changes. The two supplied units are head-text excerpts from line 822 onward and do not show the changed range. I read them as unchanged surrounding context only, and they describe existing behavior such as deadlines, MTP, sampling and MiMo. Each of the three controls is a performance or numerical-ordering setting. The doc states that none changes a token and that teacher-forced accuracy is unchanged. That claim cannot be verified from the supplied evidence, and no implementation source was provided. It does not affect the prefix-cache, T-041, or attestation conclusions. The prose does not weaken any control or alter any threat-model assumption. The code the doc describes (NAX kernels and fusion) is not in this batch. If it ships elsewhere, a reviewer should check memory ownership and the GPU residual-data behavior in T-028, but this PR gives no evidence of a regression. No findings.
